title: Pandora is still alive after getting run over by Spotify and Apple, and the CEO says his comeback plan will open up another big business in music (P, AAPL, SPOT)
text: Pandora is still alive after getting run over by Spotify and Apple, and the CEO says his comeback plan will open up another big business in music (P, AAPL, SPOT) By Troy Wolverton Jul 13, 2018, 4:44 pm 35 pts Spotify and Apple Music have been dominating the streaming music business of late, growing their number of users by the tens of millions. But Roger Lynch, CEO of Pandora, thinks his company's service can carve out a profitable niche next to those two giants. Pandora has been shedding users and ad…
